backend/main.mo: Motoko actor defining a recordings store with CRUD operations (add, get, getAll, remove, update, getByTag) using a Map keyed by auto-incremented IDs and sorted by creation time.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping each product feature (add lecture, list view, search/filter, delete, theming) to the frontend source files and test IDs that implement them.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-sentence descriptions of every frontend source file, serving as a quick reference for the project's frontend structure.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base stylesheet defining OKLCH-based CSS custom property tokens for light and dark color themes including background, card, primary, and sidebar variables.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point titled 'Lecture Link Saver' that mounts the React app into a root div via the Vite module script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that sets up TanStack Router with a root layout route (Layout + Outlet) and two child routes: '/' (LectureListPage) and '/add' (AddLecturePage), plus a Sonner Toaster.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: App shell component rendering a sticky header with logo, 'My Lectures' and 'Add Lecture' nav links, a main content slot, and a branded footer with active-route highlighting.
frontend/src/components/LectureCard.tsx: Card component that displays a single recording's title, color-coded tag badge, notes preview, formatted creation date, an external-link button, and a delete button backed by an AlertDialog confirmation.
frontend/src/components/LectureFilters.t: Filter bar component providing a keyword search input and a tag/category Select dropdown, with a clear-all button that appears when any filter is active.
frontend/src/components/LectureForm.tsx: A React form component for adding a lecture with title, URL, description, and tag fields, including validation, submission handling, and a success state display.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (authenticated or anonymous) using React Query, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider and useInternetIdentity hook for managing ICP Internet Identity authentication state, including login, logout, and identity persistence via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching, adding, removing, and updating recordings by calling the ICP backend actor, with cache invalidation on mutations.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that imports Google Fonts (Lora and Inter), sets up Tailwind directives, and defines light and dark theme CSS custom properties for a warm cream/amber color palette.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AddLecturePage.tsx: A page component that renders the LectureForm inside a card layout, handles lecture submission via the addRecording mutation, and navigates back to the home page on success.
frontend/src/pages/LectureListPage.tsx: A page component that displays all saved lecture recordings with search and tag filtering, skeleton loading states, error handling, and delete functionality.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration for the frontend, extending the default theme with custom fonts (Lora, Inter), oklch-based color tokens, border radii, box shadows, and keyframe animations, while enabling typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project state manifest describing the 'Lecture Link Saver' app, listing five implemented frontend features (save, list, search/filter, delete, theming) and three pending backend/architectural requests (data model, API, drive-style storage).
